# [BUG] Admin deploy/destroy requires manually-set GitHub PAT, breaking zero-touch orchestration

## Bug
The Admin Dashboard's Live Infrastructure Orchestrator (`DeployControl.jsx`, from #146) required a GitHub Personal Access Token to be manually placed in `VITE_GITHUB_TOKEN` (build-time) or `localStorage` before Deploy/Destroy would work — confirmed live at https://filmpire-microservices-tan.vercel.app/admin, which showed "GitHub Personal Access Token or VITE_GITHUB_TOKEN is required..." on click. This contradicted #146's own acceptance criteria ("zero manual configuration, zero setup friction"). Baking the PAT into `VITE_GITHUB_TOKEN` was also a secrets-exposure risk, since Vite inlines env vars into the public JS bundle.

## Root Cause
The GitHub Actions `workflow_dispatch` call was made directly from the browser, so it needed a client-held token. There was also no auth gate on `/admin` at all, so a client-held write-scoped token would have been publicly reachable.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Critical
**Priority (business urgency):** P1

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Fixed and verified live
- [x] Regression test added

## Notes
Resolved by removal, not by the originally-planned server-side proxy.

Commit `69e2406` first moved the PAT into a Vercel serverless function behind a shared passphrase. Commit `469e304` then deleted the web-triggered deploy path entirely — `DeployControl.jsx` and `api/dispatch.js` are gone, per ADR-015. A passphrase behind an unauthenticated `/admin` route was still a public trigger for real cloud spend, so the surface was removed rather than hardened.

`/admin` is now read-only telemetry. Deploy and destroy run from a local shell via `./gradlew deployAzure`/`deployAws`/`deployLocal` and the `destroy*` variants.

Verified: no `VITE_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `ADMIN_DISPATCH_SECRET` or `api/dispatch` references remain outside ADR-015 and a historical note in the deployment guide.
